# addons


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

[`WorkspaceAddons`](https://answerdotai.github.io/fastgws/addons.html#workspaceaddons)
manages HTTP add-on deployments and per-user test installation without
depending on Google’s discovery endpoint. It uses fastgws’
authenticated, refreshing, retrying transport against the documented
REST paths; the discovery-backed
[`GWSApi`](https://answerdotai.github.io/fastgws/core.html#gwsapi)
remains the default for services whose discovery document is available.

## Project and deployments

Authorization exposes the service-account identity Google uses for
system ID tokens and the OAuth client audience used for user ID tokens.
Deployment listing is a read-only way to inspect the project before
changing it.


*Get the project’s add-on callback authorization identities*

`deploy` uses the API’s replace operation: the same call creates a
missing deployment or replaces an existing one. This gives iterative
tooling one idempotent operation instead of a list-then-create-or-update
branch.

## Test installation

Test installation belongs to the authenticated user, so use a separate
[`WorkspaceAddons`](https://answerdotai.github.io/fastgws/addons.html#workspaceaddons)
instance for each tester’s credentials. `ensure_installed` is the
idempotent initial setup operation. After replacing a live development
deployment, `reinstall` deliberately uninstalls and installs it again so
host applications pick up the new callback configuration.

### WorkspaceAddons.install_status

``` python
async def install_status(
    deployment_id:str
):
```

*Get this user’s test-installation status*

A complete first-time setup reads the callback identities, replaces one
stable deployment, and ensures the active tester has it installed.
Subsequent callback changes use `reinstall` after `deploy`:

``` python
creds = await oauth_creds(account='developer@example.com', internal=True,
    scopes=[WorkspaceAddons.scope])
addons = WorkspaceAddons('my-project', creds)
auth = await addons.authorization()
deployment = await addons.deploy('dev', manifest)
status = await addons.ensure_installed('dev')

updated = await addons.deploy('dev', updated_manifest)
refreshed = await addons.reinstall('dev')
(auth.serviceAccountEmail, updated.name, refreshed.installed)
```
